summary: First full test run of NEXORA (FastAPI+MongoDB+React). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (35 pytest cases covering health, catalog, auth/roles, seller CRUD+entitlement gating, subscriptions, store builder publish/unpublish, cart/wishlist/addresses/checkout/orders, reviews) — 35/35 passing. Frontend (Playwright on public URL): home, category dropdown+category page, listing/search, deals, shops, product detail (gallery/variants/tabs/add-to-cart), public storefront /shop/dhaka-threads with themed hero + 5 tabs, customer login->/account, seller login->/seller/dashboard, RequireAuth role guard (customer blocked from seller dashboard), all 13 seller sidebar sections, add-product create, store builder save+persist, themes apply on GROW + lock banner on START, subscription plan switch START<->GROW, View my store, full seller signup->4-step onboarding->dashboard, cart->checkout->place order->order visible in /account/orders, wishlist toggle. All core flows PASS; no console errors, no 5xx. Verified seed integrity after tests: 95 products, 13 published shops; all test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection/lockout — 7 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 and the valid password still works immediately (no rate limit, no attempt counter).

Full-replace semantics: ProductBody defaults are written on every PUT, so a partial payload silently resets omitted fields (status->'draft', stock->0, images->[], is_featured->false). Use exclude_unset / PATCH semantics.
No stock validation or stock decrement — an out-of-stock product (stock=0) can still be ordered and inventory never changes after an order.
No purchase verification and no one-review-per-user-per-product constraint; the same user can post unlimited reviews and move a product's average rating arbitrarily.

allow_credentials=True combined with default CORS_ORIGINS='*' is an invalid combination (browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin). Works today only because auth uses Bearer headers.
Admin is only inserted when missing; changing ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env never updates the existing admin hash (non-idempotent seed).
Dead code: unused local imports (db.client, os) and unused backend_url variable in upload_file.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never calls the backend cart/wishlist APIs — grep for 'cart/sync' | 'wishlist/sync' | 'api/cart' | 'api/wishlist' in /app/frontend/src returns 0 hits. StoreContext keeps cart/wishlist in localStorage only, so a logged-in customer's cart/wishlist is lost on another device or after clearing storage (verified: server cart/wishlist stayed empty after adding 2 items in the browser). GET/POST /api/cart(/sync) and /api/wishlist(/sync) are implemented and pass tests but are unused.

Checkout collects a delivery address inline but does not persist it to the address book (/api/account/addresses stays empty after placing an order) and does not use address_id; /account/addresses still shows 'No addresses yet' after a successful order.

issues: The '-17%' discount badge and the 'Sold out' badge are stacked at the same top-left position and visually overlap on sold-out discounted cards.

Banner/product images are reused across different shops in the same category (Crumb & Co. and Sweet Symphony share the same bakery banner; Glow Lab and Rupasi Beauty share the same image), which makes the marketplace look duplicated.
Some product images do not match the title (e.g. 'Cable Organizer' shows over-ear headphones, 'Gym Duffel Bag' shows shoes/dumbbells).

action_items: Wire the frontend StoreContext to /api/cart(/sync) and /api/wishlist(/sync): hydrate from server after login and push on change (merge with local guest cart) so cart/wishlist persist across sessions/devices.
Save the checkout address to /api/account/addresses (or pass address_id) so the Addresses page reflects orders placed.
Make PUT /api/seller/products/{id} partial-update safe (model_dump(exclude_unset=True)) so omitted fields aren't reset.
Validate/decrement stock during POST /api/checkout and reject out-of-stock items.
Restrict duplicate reviews per user/product (and ideally require a delivered order) in POST /api/reviews.
Set explicit CORS origins when allow_credentials=True, and add basic login rate-limiting/lockout.
Fix overlapping discount/'Sold out' badges and diversify seed images so different shops/products don't share identical photos.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins default '*' — invalid per CORS spec; derive origins from FRONTEND_URL.
seller.py update_product uses body.model_dump() (all defaults) inside $set — data-loss risk on partial updates.
commerce.py checkout is stock-agnostic: no availability check, no stock decrement, no order-total recalculation guard against product deletion mid-checkout.
catalog.py create_review allows unlimited reviews from the same user, directly recomputing product rating — rating manipulation vector.
frontend StoreContext.jsx duplicates cart state in localStorage while backend cart/wishlist endpoints exist unused — single source of truth violation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested core flows (2 integration gaps found: cart/wishlist server sync, checkout address persistence)

rca_of_the_issue: Cart/wishlist gap: StoreContext.jsx initialises state from localStorage and writes back on every change, with no effect that hydrates from GET /api/cart|/api/wishlist after login and no POST to the */sync endpoints. Reproduce: log in as customer@nexora.com, quick-add 2 products (badge shows 2), then open a fresh browser context and log in again — the cart is empty while MongoDB carts.items for that user stays []. Mitigation: on auth state change, GET server cart/wishlist, merge with local guest state, then POST /api/cart/sync & /api/wishlist/sync on every mutation (debounced).
